success.description: M A tide of verminkind seeks to overrun the intended victim. The attack inflicts normal damage
M4 As above, and the target suffers 1 fatigue for each skaven engaged with the target

bane.description: Engaged skaven suffer the Exposed condition for 2 rounds

chaosStar.description: Move the topmost skaven initiative counter down one space on the matrix track

conservative.requirements: Used By: Clat, Gutter Runner Engaged with target Special: If the attacker is within close range of at least three other skaven, reduce the difficulty modifier by {Dc}
conservative.name: The Overwhelming Horde

success.description: 4 You and your allies attempt to overwhelm the victim. The attack inflicts normal damage
As above, and the target suffers 1 fatigue, plus 1 fatigue for each of your allies engaged with him

boon.description: Draw critical wounds equal to the number of your allies within close range. Choose 1 to apply to the target and discard the rest

bane.description: The target gains +1 to his next attack against you or one of your allies

reckless.requirements: Engaged with target Special: If you are within close range of at least two allies, reduce the difficulty modifier by {Dc}
reckless.name: The Overwhelming Horde
